name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of kitchen drywall depends on square footage, ceiling height, whether existing drywall must be demolished, and the required finish level. Pricing factors include material type—such as standard versus moisture-resistant boards—and the labor needed for taping around multiple electrical cutouts, plumbing penetrations, and soffits. Full kitchen remodels that involve framing repairs or moving walls cost more than hanging board on open studs. Choosing a smooth Level 5 finish for glossy paint also requires more labor and mudding passes than a standard Level 4 finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on room size, ceiling height, demolition needs, board type (standard vs. moisture-resistant), and the required finish level to accommodate lighting and paint.
